text:
maya: Customer Nimbus is ready to sign if we can commit to a 99.9% VPC SLA for private + a concrete low-downtime upgrade path. Also asking for a one-time migration credit and a discounted reserved tier for first 12 months. Quick sync?

sam: do we have precedent for 99.9% on private? that's high for on-prem network variability.

liam: 99.9% is doable for infra we control (control plane + private agent), but we need explicit SLO carveouts for customer-managed networking (peering/NAT/DNS). otherwise it's misleading.

natalie: field asks: they want a simple roll-forward with <1h node restart window and a clear rollback plan. they also want upgrade costs split: infra upgrade included, network peering changes billed separately.

maya: propose acceptance criteria draft:
- upgrade window <= 1h for minor patches
- rollback to previous version within 30m
- automated preflight checks (agent + connectivity)
- visible per-tenant upgrade status in console
- support: 24x7 for first 30 days, then business hours

sam: engineer constraints: preflight checks must include KV cache compatibility, model pinned versions, and schema validation for config. can we add an automatic health-check step that aborts upgrade if latency >20%?

sam: example preflight command:
```
redwoodctl preflight --agent <agent-id> --checks connectivity,kvcache,model-compat
```

liam: health-check abort on >20% latency is fine. network carveouts: if customer-managed NAT/IP changes required, we'll document costs and timeline; if our agent needs re-provisioning due to network change, we absorb the engineering work for the first migration only.

natalie: pricing concession idea from field: 50% off first-month reserved capacity + one migration engineering-day included (to be used within 90 days). keep offer time-limited and attach a clear migration playbook.

maya: sounds reasonable. next steps: sam to draft technical acceptance criteria, liam to draft customer-facing upgrade SLA with carveouts, natalie to own field offer language and contract clause. can we have PRDs by EOD Friday?

sam: i'll put up a short doc + checklist. ping @natalie for wording.

natalie: i'll draft the field offer and sample contract clause, will loop legal and sales ops.

deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly private-deploy sync in 2h — agenda item: launch gating.

maya: thanks team. if legal flags anything, escalate to me. :thumbsup:
